title: Did the sprinkler change rain?
hook: Did the sprinkler change rain? Change one condition and inspect the result.

knows: that a toy model states its assumptions

misconception: Rain and sprinkler are independent fair binary variables. Grass is wet if either occurs. Given wet grass, then learning the sprinkler ran, what is rain probability? The prediction alternatives contrast different consequences of the stated model.
objective: grass is wet; learning the sprinkler was on makes rain *less* likely.
